conceptZh: 玩具機器人站在小果樹下張開雙手準備接蘋果，蘋果卻不偏不倚輕輕落在他頭頂上；他一動也不動地頂著蘋果站好，還慢慢比出一個讚，接著蘋果攤平成上面的「田」，樹幹伸展成下面的「木」，合成「果」。
object: a small toy robot, a little toy fruit tree and one big apple
morph: the apple flattens into the 田 on top while the trunk and branches stretch into the 木 below, forming 果
creativeAngle: 笑點是「張開雙手接，結果接到頭上」的老派物理喜劇，輕輕一碰不痛不嚇人；而蘋果在上、樹幹在下正好就是果字的田在上、木在下，變形邏輯完全對上。果只有八畫，適合完整組裝。語音詞「水果」，水ㄕㄨㄟˇ已學過，兩字都是單一讀音。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale sky background. Centered stands a stubby toy fruit tree with one large glossy red apple hanging from it, and a small boxy toy robot plants himself underneath with both hands cupped open, absolutely ready. From 1.0 second the apple wobbles, detaches - and lands softly on the flat top of his head with a gentle bonk, nowhere near his waiting hands. He does not flinch. He stays perfectly still, apple balanced, hands still cupped. Beat. At 2.4 seconds, without moving his head a millimetre, he slowly raises one thumb. At 3.0 seconds the apple flattens and squares off above him into a neat box divided by a cross of strokes, while the tree's trunk and branches stretch and straighten beneath it into a crossed upright with two sweeping strokes at the base. The robot steps out from between them and hops out of frame to the right by 4.4 seconds. By 4.8 seconds the shapes have resolved into one correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 果 in saturated deep crimson, perfectly centered and uncropped, filling about 70% of the frame height with generous margins, its upper 田 and lower 木 clearly separated and every stroke crisp. From 4.9 to 8.0 seconds the frame holds completely still on 果 with nothing else moving in the shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「果、果、水果」, using the reading ㄍㄨㄛˇ for 果 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 果 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 水果 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 果: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.
